# settings.kept under a `for`, one per row, each under the row's own name.
#
# kept is `kept[T, F]`, F its family, which nothing binds at a call site with
# no children. Under a `for` it is built at run time, and a target that does
# not emit a generic component copies one per instantiation -- but only when
# the call site bound every type parameter, so kept was emitted with T in it,
# and its load[T] asked for a codec of T: "PlanCodec reached T" on html,
# fyne, gtk4 and android. A family parameter left unbound no longer stops
# the copy (componentInstance); a built-in, whose body is the host's, is not
# copied. bubbletea refused the program until a per-copy effect could read a
# prop bound to the loop variable (component_effect_reads_loop_prop_runs.txt),
# and html until a runtime instance's `default` prop had a local it could
# bind (runtime_instance_reserved_prop_runs.txt).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import settings "sngl:settings"
import "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Row {
    name  string
    count option[int]
}

component app ui.node {
    var shown = true
    var rows = [Row{name="a", count=null}, Row{name="b", count=null}]

    if shown {
        for var &row = rows {
            settings.kept(name=row.name, default=0, :value=row.count)
        }
    }
}

func testEachRowStartsAtTheDefault(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.rows[0].count == 0)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].count == 0)
    t.assert(settings.load[int]("a") == null)
}

func testEachRowKeepsUnderItsOwnName(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.rows[1].count = 5
    t.assert(settings.load[int]("b") == 5)
    t.assert(settings.load[int]("a") == null)
}

func testARemountReadsEachRowBack(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.rows[0].count = 3
    c.rows[1].count = 4
    c.shown = false
    c.rows = [Row{name="a", count=null}, Row{name="b", count=null}]
    c.shown = true
    t.assert(c.rows[0].count == 3)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].count == 4)
}
